name: Toujou Kirumi
source:
"I have a duty to cooperate with all of my power, since you said we should."

A super high school student with a keen mind and talented in various sports. While working a part time job as a maid, she’s able to carry out any job, and has created a reputation for doing perfect work. In the past, she was even selected as a bodyguard for visiting heads of state. However, she says that of course she turned down the job in order to not ruin a country, according to her words.

Kirumi is a refined, mature young lady. Kirumi’s creed as a maid is “Duty before self.” Even under the extreme condition of being locked inside the Prison School for the Gifted, her will to work for the sake of others doesn’t change, and she takes care of cooking and cleaning for the other students. 

[Edited from [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/153867632773/ndrv3-famitsu-info-for-december-1st-2016-like-i]jinjojess's translation[/url]]
